IC2: - males [OR] and females [AND] who are physically healthy;
IC3: - diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder based on clinical evaluation and DSM-5 criteria, and confirmed using the Autism Diagnostic Interview-Revised, and the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule;
IC4: - care provider who could reliably bring subject to clinic visits, could provide trustworthy ratings, and interacted with subject on a regular basis;
IC5: - ability of subject to swallow the compound;
IC6: - stable concomitant medications for at least 2 weeks (4 weeks if patient took fluoxetine);
IC7: - [NOT] no planned changes in psychosocial interventions during the open-label trial.
